prompt: Using a materially different reviewer-held provider-free module, explain and defend its type system, expression flow, instance identity, dependency graph, known/unknown values, tests and saved-plan consequences with exact Terraform and OpenTofu versions. Do not use lesson answers, credentials, a backend, external providers or apply.
deliverables: Exact product/version/platform/digest, acquisition evidence and provenance limitations.
Module root, source revision, file inventory and variable-source precedence.
Type and validation table covering defaults, nulls, optional fields, sensitive values and two negative cases.
Expression trace through variables, locals, functions, conditions and collection transforms.
Expanded module/resource addresses with count or for_each identity rationale.
Dependency graph with implicit and explicit edges, cycles, parallel branches and readiness limits.
Known, sensitive and unknown value map with propagation into outputs and policy.
Format, backend-disabled initialization, validation and plan-only native test evidence.
Saved plans produced separately by both CLIs and reviewed by address, action, values and unknowns.
Compatibility conclusion limited to exact observed semantics and documented differences.
Proof of no credentials, external provider/module, backend, state, apply, network side effect or remote resource.
Exact cleanup, proof limits, remediation and delayed second unseen transfer.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies a module not derived from LES-0038 and with different collection/identity shapes.
Raw outputs are sanitized and bound to product, version, path, revision and UTC time.
At least one initially plausible but invalid assumption is corrected from evidence.
At least one negative variable case and one plan-unknown assertion boundary are demonstrated.
Opaque plan files are never crossed between products and are removed after evidence extraction.
Reviewer observes final absence and confirms no apply or external access occurred.
A second unseen case after delay changes identity or unknown-value semantics.

rubric.observableEvidence: Pins products, digests, source, inputs and trust limits.
Explains exact contracts, defaults, nulls and refusals.
Expanded addresses and stable-key reasoning are correct.
Edges, concurrency, cycles and readiness limits are correct.
Known, sensitive and unknown propagation is correct.
Positive, negative and plan-phase assertions are reproducible.
Every action and material value is reviewed by address.
No apply/external authority and exact absence are observed.
Decision, uncertainty, limits and next evidence are clear.
